name: ENGR 3024
title: Adv - Building our Sistas Strength (BOSS) Leveraging Adversity, Diversity and Intellect (LADI)
description: The course is the second course in the BOSS LADI series. It is intended to continue to build upon the confidence, communication, and leadership skills of students in the course, particularly  Black and Latine in STEM so that they have the agency and ability to step into leadership roles (especially in higher levels of management) in varying environments (academia, government, industry, etc.) and know they can affect change. This course will also assist students in preparation for academic success through exposure to resources, guest speakers, and discussions in and outside of class. While this course is designed to support the success of Black and Latine women, anyone can take the course. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
